In [[geometry]] of the Euclidean plane, a '''33344-33434 tiling''' is one of two of 20 [[2-uniform tiling]]s of the [[Euclidean plane]] [[Tiling by regular polygons|by regular polygons]]. They contains regular [[triangle]] and [[square]] faces, arranged in two [[vertex configuration]]: 3.3.3.4.4 and 3.3.4.3.4.<ref>Chavey (1989)</ref> 

The first has triangles in groups of 3 and square in groups of 1 and 2. It has 4 types of faces and 5 types of edges. 

The second has triangles in groups of 4, and squares in groups of 2. It has 3 types of face and 6 types of edges.

== Circle Packings ==
These 2-uniform tilings can be used as a [[Circle packing|circle packings]].

In the first 2-uniform tiling (whose dual resembles a key-lock pattern): cyan circles are in contact with 5 other circles ('''3''' cyan, '''2''' pink), corresponding to the V3<sup>3</sup>.4<sup>2</sup> planigon, and pink circles are also in contact with 5 other circles ('''4''' cyan, '''1''' pink), corresponding to the V3<sup>2</sup>.4.3.4 planigon. It is [[Homeomorphism|homeomorphic]] to the ambo operation on the tiling, with the cyan and pink gap polygons corresponding to the cyan and pink circles (mini-vertex configuration polygons; one dimensional duals to the respective planigons). Both images coincide.

In the second 2-uniform tiling (whose dual resembles jagged streams of water): cyan circles are in contact with 5 other circles ('''2''' cyan, '''3''' pink), corresponding to the V3<sup>3</sup>.4<sup>2</sup> planigon, and pink circles are also in contact with 5 other circles ('''3''' cyan, '''2''' pink), corresponding to the V3<sup>2</sup>.4.3.4 planigon. It is [[Homeomorphism|homeomorphic]] to the ambo operation on the tiling, with the cyan and pink gap polygons corresponding to the cyan and pink circles (mini-vertex configuration polygons; one dimensional duals to the respective planigons). Both images coincide.

=== Dual tilings===
The dual tilings have [[right triangle]] and [[Kite (geometry)|kite]] faces, defined by [[face configuration]]s: V3.3.3.4.4 and V3.3.4.3.4, and can be seen combining the [[prismatic pentagonal tiling]] and [[Cairo pentagonal tiling]]s.
